about: Previous-release tests allowed to fail against the new source, because behaviour changed on purpose (workspace letter H6, rule 3; scripts/release/previous-tests.ts). Each entry: the test file and name, the version the change ships in, and why. A test failing that is not listed fails the release gate.

entries.name: GC: wasmer and wazero
entries.reason: The refusal names the date the profile was measured; D4 was re-measured on 2026-10-24 (was 2026-10-23), so the message says 'measured 2026-10-24'. The refusal itself is unchanged.

entries.name: tail calls, multi-memory, br_on_non_null
entries.reason: Tail calls are portable (owner, 2026-10-24: 'Make them portable'): wasmer runs every tail call; D4 excluded them on a measurement artifact (the probe passed wasmer its own refused --enable-tail-call switch). --target portable now keeps a tail call instead of refusing it.

entries.name: every excluded feature at once, not only the first
entries.reason: Its module combined a tail call with GC and expected both refused; tail calls are portable since 2.1.0 (above), so only GC is refused. The 2.1.0 test combines GC and multi-memory.

entries.name: checkTarget refuses a module outside the profile
entries.reason: Its module was a tail call, which is inside the profile since 2.1.0 (tail calls portable, above). The 2.1.0 test uses a GC module.
